scenes.text: Costa Rica is the entry point. Not just any country — the country that already sells wellness to the world. Wellness tourism estimated at 1.2 billion dollars. Blue Zone. Wellness Pura Vida. The ecosystem is culturally ready for this.
scenes.visual_direction: Aerial view of Costa Rica Pacific coastline at golden hour, Nosara peninsula, tropical forest meeting the ocean, soft mist, warm amber light, no people, cinematic landscape photography, 8K photorealistic

scenes.text: Costa Rica already has everything: yoga, breathwork, sound bowls, plant medicine. But what doesn't exist is a premium, substance-free inner journey with proprietary sound technology and a careful protocol. That's the gap.
scenes.visual_direction: A minimalist sound installation space at dusk, the Harmonic Beacon device glowing softly in the center of an empty bamboo pavilion, warm amber light contrasting with deep blue twilight outside, premium spa aesthetic, no people, photorealistic

scenes.text: Three formats. Simple. Sellable today. Pop-up experience inside existing retreats. Anchor B2B pilot with an eco-resort. Founding facilitator cohort. Nothing to build that isn't ready.
scenes.visual_direction: Three elegant dark cards floating in space, each with a minimalist icon (circle of people, handshake, single figure with glow), premium gold-on-black typography, clean layout, no text rendered by AI

scenes.text: We did the work. 44 pages of operational analysis, 69 directives, buyer personas, protocols, and governance behind every decision. The result is simple but not simplistic.
scenes.visual_direction: An elegant workspace with documents layered on a dark wood desk, a laptop open, the Beacon device resting powered off beside it, warm desk lamp lighting, intellectual atmosphere, no people, photorealistic

scenes.text: What we choose not to do is as important as what we do. No standalone hardware. No mass certification. No clinical claims. No substances. No extractive decor. Each no protects the yes.
scenes.visual_direction: A minimalist shield or crest design, geometric and precise, matte black surface with gold edge highlights, one glowing amber point at the center, premium brand identity aesthetic, no text

scenes.text: The in-person Beacon sells trust. Training multiplies distribution. Licensing captures recurrence. The app retains. AI scales later. But the first step is in-person, paid, and carefully held. That's what we're doing in Costa Rica right now.
scenes.visual_direction: The Beacon device lit and glowing warmly in a completely dark premium space, warm amber light radiating outward, peaceful and inviting atmosphere, the light suggesting a doorway or invitation, photorealistic, cinematic
